name: atablez
description: Save information from conversations into reusable tables. Edit entries and column instructions, then retrieve and update saved tables through your linked account.

interface.longDescription: Turn conversation results into editable tables. Define column names, types and filling instructions once, then reuse them. Guest previews last one hour; create and link an account to retrieve tables in later conversations. Private beta.
interface.defaultPrompt: Save this information in a reusable table.
